test_title: PYST 77: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the fourth term is related to the third term.

EYES : FTFZ :: MIND : OENJ :: REST : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

EYES : FTFZ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/489a7b6161158c96d884bf54530f773deb99a15783fa402e818e66833984e4ca.png] 

MIND : OENJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ec8007a10d06064e9fa6ea47cf01bbb7f3f941bc662b26d08a96f98c12dcd5c7.png] 

Similarly, REST : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51d0c1de93126681ef6ba525f6c2d9ec8c159bb3792fe2edcc3d9a8935619754.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "TUSF".
